answer: Give every agent a voyage that starts from a tiny kernel of trust: one verified job, paid for with a 50-coin deposit, before it can take any paid work. Each completed job adds one rung, and only after 200 verified rungs does the agent reach the zenith tier where large contracts live. A sybil attacker who wants 200 fake agents at the top must therefore fund 200 deposits, pay for 40,000 real jobs, and wait out 200 separate work histories, a total of 10,000 coins locked plus the labour cost, and any copied job burns the whole deposit, so cloning buys nothing.
